page: Amazon Web Services trn3.48xlarge is a high-density accelerated computing instance designed for large-scale deep learning model training and inference. Engineered on the AWS Nitro system, the platform pairs 16 Annapurna Trainium3 accelerators with an Intel x86_64 host processor. The host configuration delivers 96 physical cores and 192 dedicated vCPUs clocked at a base frequency of 2.4 GHz, avoiding hypervisor oversubscription for core compute tasks.

The instance is equipped with 2048.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 10.67 GB per physical core. Accelerator capacity totals 2304 GB across the 16 Trainium3 devices. For high-speed data feeding and temporary checkpoint persistence, the instance bundles 7600 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Node-to-node communication is backed by 3200 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth, designed to reduce gradient transfer bottlenecks across distributed cluster topologies.

Hardware consolidation on this scale delivers high computational density per host, though utilization relies on AWS Neuron SDK integration rather than standard CUDA environments. The server is optimized for pre-training large language models, large-scale transformer fine-tuning, complex multi-modal training architectures, and high-throughput model inference pipelines.
